label: Every actual distinct esse has some cause of being
paraphrase: OPEN analyst premise, attribution deferred: for every x that actually exists with esse distinct from its essence (DistinctEsseAt), some c causes x's esse (CausesIn c x esse, the tenseless cause of being, mode not fixed by the type). It does not say that c is other than x. It is the exact extra premise that turns 'not self-caused' into 'caused by another': with no self-causation the cause is distinct. Brute esse rejects it; a non-causal intrinsic or structural account rejects it unless its explainer is counted as a being that causes x's esse. Its De ente decomposition is the efficiently read nature-or-other exhaustiveness plus the self-causation reading.
